name: First orbiter at Mars
description: The Program has its first spacecraft in orbit around Mars, and the world is watching.

name: First landing on Mars
description: The Program has put a working spacecraft on the surface of Mars, and the pictures are on every front page.

name: First rover on Mars
description: The Program has a rover driving on Mars, and people everywhere are following where it goes next.

name: First Crew at Mars
description: The Program has people at Mars for the first time, and the whole world is watching them.

name: First Crew on the surface
description: The Program's Crew have landed on Mars, and the first footprints are on every screen in the world.

name: First Crew home
description: The Program has brought its Crew home from Mars alive, and the whole world is cheering their return.

name: First samples returned
description: The Program has brought rock and soil from Mars back to Earth, and laboratories everywhere are queuing to study them.

name: 700 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 700 Science, and its first results are in the news as well as the journals.

name: 1200 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 1200 Science, and schools and museums everywhere are teaching what it found.

name: 1800 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 1800 Science, and it has changed what people think they know about Mars.

name: 2400 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 2400 Science, and its discoveries are now the reason people give for going to Mars.

name: 3000 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 3000 Science, and the world thinks of Mars as a place people have come to understand.
